title: Change of localized base with second factor fixed
statement: Let $R,R_p,A,B,D$ be commutative rings, $R_p$ a localization of $R$ at a multiplicative submonoid $S$, and $A$ and $B$ $R_p$-algebras with compatible $R$-algebra structures. Suppose $D$ has maps from $A\otimes_R B$ and $A\otimes_{R_p} B$ whose restrictions to $A$ and $B$ agree. Use the complex and scalar extension conventions of [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. For every integer $i$, complex $Q$ of $A$-modules and base-derived tensor cohomology models $L$ over $(R,A,B)$ and $K$ over $(R_p,A,B)$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], there exists a family of $D$-linear isomorphisms $D\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}H_L^i\cong D\otimes_{A\otimes_{R_p} B}H_K^i$. This family commutes with localized comparison for every ordinary-complex identification fixing $d\otimes x$, and is natural for all counit-compatible model morphisms and cohomology maps characterized by $\mathrm{cohomologyIso}$. Both $Q$ and $B$ remain fixed; only the base is localized.

proof.text: For each complex and pair of models choose the canonical characterized isomorphism supplied by lem-pc-base-localization-iso. The generator formula determines its forward morphism uniquely by IsBaseLocalizationMap.ext, so this is not an arbitrary existence witness. Apply the comparison theorem pointwise and apply naturality to each pair of chosen maps. Pair the two resulting universally quantified statements.

theorem derivedTensor_base_localization_models
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S Rp]
    (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
        (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
        (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A B Q D),
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj
            (L.cohomology i) ≅
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] B) D)).obj
            (K.cohomology i),
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A B Q D)
          (τ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ≅
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[Rp] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q),
          (∀ (j : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X j),
            τ.hom.f j (d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) =
              d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] B) D).comp
                (algebraMap A (A ⊗[Rp] B))] x) →
          L.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i =
            (e Q L K).hom ≫ K.localizedComparison i) ∧
      (∀ (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q')
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A B Q D)
          (L' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q' D)
          (K' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A B Q' D)
          (δ : L.derived ⟶ L'.derived) (ε : K.derived ⟶ K'.derived)
          (g : L.cohomology i ⟶ L'.cohomology i)
          (h : K.cohomology i ⟶ K'.cohomology i),
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) δ ≫
            L'.counit = L.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map g ≫
              (L'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (L.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (L.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R A).obj Q')))) →
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} Rp)) ε ≫
            K'.counit = K.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[Rp] A ⊗[Rp] B).toRingHom).map h ≫
              (K'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (K.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (K.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} Rp) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict Rp A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (ε.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} Rp) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict Rp A).obj Q')))) →
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map g ≫
            (e Q' L' K').hom =
          (e Q L K).hom ≫
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] B) D)).map h)
